gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-almendra: Commanding and expressive, Funnel Display looks drawn in cord. Almendra sits beneath it as a dignified serif with a deep midsection, giving those uniform loops a bookish, shaded counterpart.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-bree-serif: Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like lines with no thick-to-thin shading. Bree Serif follows in outsized lowercase, so a slightly smaller body size will keep its large proportions from crowding the heading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-port-lligat-sla: Strokes that keep their width through every turn give Funnel Display its cord-like, commanding look. Port Lligat Slab answers with wide, glassy lowercase counters made for steady reading.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-quando: Quando spreads its letters out sparsely, each word built around a big, tall middle zone. Funnel Display opposes that with curves as heavy as its stems, like cord, and that unshaded line against Quando's shading is the pair's strongest quality.
gen-gf-gabarito-author: Expressive and distinctive, Gabarito looks like glass tubing, hollow and constant in thickness from one letter to the next. Author's slight swell on the bowls handles the quieter reading.
gen-gf-gabarito-cabin: One-nib drawing, with terminals cut open so counters flow outward, defines Gabarito. It carries the personality up top, while Cabin's bent-tube letters keep the text warm and easy to follow.
gen-gf-gabarito-dm-sans: Approachable and friendly, DM Sans spreads its s terminals wide. Its low contrast against Gabarito's pipe-cleaner-slim joins is what makes the pair memorable.
gen-gf-gabarito-fs-paquito: Paquito leaves only a minimal gap between x-height and caps, which gives it a confident, approachable look. And Gabarito's moderate lowercase beside it keeps a long page feeling friendly rather than crowded.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-aleo: Aleo lets the eye slip in and out of its counters, dignified and classic as a text serif. Aleo looks best a touch larger than you'd expect, against Gabarito's single-stroke brush heading.
gen-gf-gabarito-gf-almendra-sc: Authoritative and dignified, Almendra SC keeps its mouths open on c, e, and a. Almendra SC makes a longer stretch of text feel unhurried, with a text serif's steady, ink-lit rhythm.
